title: Guarded Scientific Model Orchestration
summary: A state-aware orchestration layer that extends LLM function calling with explicit workflow semantics so domain scientists can invoke trained prediction models through constrained natural language.
details: Accumulates required inputs across multiple turns and validates arguments against typed schemas.
Blocks model execution when workflow state is incomplete instead of guessing missing values.
Supports correction, what-if exploration, and reset steering while keeping execution boundaries visible.

title: Kona Token Trade
summary: Backend service work for a blockchain-based token-trading platform, centered on reliable service communication, latency-conscious caching, and stronger controls for sensitive operations.
details: Contributed to trade, user, wallet, and fee-management services without claiming ownership of the full platform.
Introduced message queues to improve reliability between services and caching to reduce response latency.
Implemented two-factor authentication for sensitive trading operations; proprietary details and internal metrics remain excluded.

title: Bangla Sign Language Recognition
summary: Undergraduate thesis research that contributed to a published hybrid recognition system combining image preprocessing, transfer learning, and a random-forest classifier.
details: Designed and evaluated the background-elimination preprocessing method.
Helped integrate preprocessing with the transfer-learning and random-forest recognition pipeline.
The multi-author system reported 91.67% character accuracy and 97.33% digit accuracy on open Bangla Sign Language datasets.
